## Why

K0's least-power ladder puts framework-free custom elements third —
above framework islands, below HTML/CSS — and UXK0-4 names the roster.
P35.50 built the admission machinery (the page-type registry and the
then-empty `t1-module-entries.json` allow-list); P36.19 built the strict
CSP (`script-src 'self'` + per-page hashes). This row lands the first
elements through that machinery: the allow-list stops being empty, and
every admitted entry is proven by the same sweeps that kept it empty
yesterday — `script-policy`, `nojs-parity`, `budget`, axe — on all 51
discovered routes.

## What ships

### The elements (`web/src/elements/`)

- **`<sig-table>`** (mounted on `/sources/`) — a text filter, per-column
  sort with `aria-sort`, multi-facet chips, a column chooser, URL view
  state restored only when it validates against the rendered model, and
  a *download this view* CSV whose `#`-comment lines carry per-row
  licence provenance for exactly the visible rows.
- **`<sig-typeahead>`** — an APG combobox shell over static
  `sig.typeahead-shard/1` shards; the wrapped plain GET form remains
  the fallback (Escape closes the popup, Enter navigates the selected
  option or submits the form); no live-spine reads.
- **`<sig-cite>`** — plain/APA/Chicago/legal restatement generated from
  server-rendered `data-cite-*` fields into a `[data-enhancement]`
  output; the original citation sentence is never rewritten.
- **`<sig-copy>`** — a clipboard affordance that reports success and
  never modifies the source text.
- **`<sig-details>`** — native disclosure plus fragment-target and
  print handling; the `<details>` element stays functional with the
  module absent or inert.
- **Pure models beside them** — `table-model.ts`, `cite-formats.ts`,
  `typeahead-model.ts` carry the state machines unit-tested under
  `tests/unit/enhancement-kit.test.ts` (22 tests).

### Emission + admission (ADR-224)

- **`sigEnhancementKit`** — an `astro:build:done` hook in
  `web/astro.config.mjs` esbuild-bundles each `src/elements/sig-*.ts`
  into `dist/_kit/sig-<name>.js` under **stable names**: the T1
  allow-list can name every admitted entry verbatim and the CSP's
  `script-src 'self'` admits them with no new directive or hash
  allowance.
- **`t1-module-entries.json`** — now names the five `/_kit/sig-*.js`
  entries; script-policy still fails closed on anything else.
- **BaseLayout** gates the cite/copy/details chrome trio on the
  page-type registry — only a full-chrome T1 page loads them, so a
  re-typed route stops emitting tags with no template edit — while
  `<sig-table>`/`<sig-typeahead>` name their own modules beside the
  markup they upgrade.
- **`ops/public_routes.toml`** admits the `_kit` prefix; the
  `/enhancement-kit/` harness itself stays internal
  (`SIG_BUILD_INTERNAL=1` only, registered T1-internal in
  `page-types.ts` — SIG-UI-089 holds on it too).

### Tests

- `tests/e2e/enhancement-kit.spec.ts` (12 legs): filter, sort +
  `aria-sort`, facet chips, column chooser, URL restoration, CSV +
  licence lines, cite-format restatement, copy success, fragment/print
  disclosure, typeahead shard fetch + cache + APG semantics + Escape/
  Enter fallback, axe on the harness, blocked-module inertness.
- `tests/e2e/enhancement-kit.nojs.spec.ts` (4 legs): rows, citation,
  GET form and disclosure complete with JavaScript off.
- Contract updates where the old text predated T1 scripts:
  `jurisdiction.nojs.spec.ts`, `watch-evidence.nojs.spec.ts` and
  `tests/e2e/test_composed_stack.py` now assert the ADR-155 contract —
  *only allow-listed `/_kit/` module entries* — not a literal zero.
